questions.questionText: Which of the following best explains why clients often ask stylists about scalp issues?

questions.questionText: What is the function of the dermal papilla within the hair follicle?
options: It produces sebum to coat the hair
It provides blood supply to support hair growth
It controls melanin production in the medulla
It anchors the follicle in the hypodermis

questions.questionText: Which statement is TRUE about follicle miniaturisation?
options: It results in stronger, thicker hairs

questions.questionText: What does high hair porosity usually indicate?
options: Hair holds moisture for long periods

questions.questionText: Which condition is associated with autoimmune causes and patchy hair loss?
